{data.tripName}



Name of Hotel: {data.nameOfHotels}
Start Date: {data.startDateOfJourney}
End Date: {data.endDateOfJourney}
Places Visited: {data.placesVisited}
Total Cost: {data.totalCost}
Trip Type: {data.tripType}


{data.experience}
); }else{ return(<> Loading... ) } }
